title: Universal Properties of Nonlinearly Perturbed Maxwell Theory
summary: We show that a general nonlinearly perturbed Maxwell theory of electromagnetism possesses three universal fundamental properties: (i) A finite-energy electric point charge. (ii) Exclusion of finite-energy magnetic monopoles and dually charged dyons. (iii) Arbitrary smallness of the effective radius of a point electric charge and the associated local undetectedness of the electric charge and energy.
